title: ChemRMBench

detail.en: 45 saved episodes in one seen geometry: 40 scripted Track C references and 5 faults. Narrow-window signed median error +0.333336 s fails the 0.1 s requirement.
detail.zh: 一个已见几何中保存 45 回合：40 个手写 Track C reference、5 个故障回合。窄窗 signed median error 为 +0.333336 s，未达 0.1 s 要求。

denominator.en: One geometry · scripted tools · no learned VLA
denominator.zh: 一个几何 · 手写工具 · 无学习型 VLA

detail.en: Four fixed seen cases meet the per-case 0.1 s timing bound; maximum absolute error 0.016668233 s. Different banks prevent a matched performance-improvement claim.
detail.zh: 四个固定已见案例逐例满足 0.1 s 计时界限；最大绝对误差 0.016668233 s。与旧实验 bank 不同，不作匹配性能提升推断。

denominator.en: 4 cases · 1 seed / geometry · no population admission
denominator.zh: 4 案例 · 1 seed / geometry · 非群体准入

detail.en: Two seen previews, 120 frames each. A has RGBD, proprioception and language; B adds only a timestamp. Static depth arrays do not establish dynamic depth freshness or the information gate.
detail.zh: 两个已见预览，每个 120 帧。A 为 RGBD、本体状态和语言，B 仅增加时间戳。静态 depth 数组不能证明动态深度新鲜度或信息门通过。

denominator.zh: 240 帧 · 2 预览 · 0 策略训练

detail.en: 20 development captures. Diagnostic marker counts are 3 / 5 / 5 across lens settings; maximum projection disagreement 0.889 px. Saved row motion is not calibrated volume or verified particle identity.
detail.zh: 20 张开发捕获。不同 lens 设置下诊断 marker 数为 3 / 5 / 5，最大投影偏差 0.889 px。保存行的移动不是标定体积或已验证粒子身份。

denominator.en: 20 captures · diagnostic markers excluded from benchmark
denominator.zh: 20 张捕获 · 诊断 marker 不进入 benchmark

title.zh: 实际 Franka 驱动轨迹

detail.en: 360 physics states and 60 nine-dimensional drive targets. Joint 1 moves 0.079997 rad and the fingers about 0.005 m. This is a limited actuator diagnostic, not a grasp or pouring evaluation.
detail.zh: 360 个物理状态、60 次九维驱动 target。joint 1 移动 0.079997 rad、finger 约 0.005 m。这是限定执行器诊断，不是抓取或倒液评测。

detail.en: 420 states, 70 captures and 71 target calls. The capacity error is cleared; maximum actual cup tilt is 89.627012° (<90°). Workspace containment also fails.
detail.zh: 420 状态、70 张捕获、71 次 target calls。容量错误已消除；实际最大杯倾角 89.627012°（小于 90°）。工作区留存同样失败。

denominator.zh: 1 次固定已见诊断 · 工程 FAIL

title.zh: 共同 home 轨迹可行性

detail.en: Five planned target trajectories pass independent CPU kinematics and limit checks, with an identical start/end home. No native run, actual home tracking, collision clearance or three-second liquid cue is established.
detail.zh: 五条规划目标轨迹通过独立 CPU 运动学与限位检查，起止为同一 home。尚无 native 运行、实际 home 跟踪、碰撞净空或三秒液体 cue 证明。

denominator.zh: 5 条 CPU 轨迹 · 0 实际 Pour 事件

detail.en: 45 legal-first archive and analytic CPU checks pass. The new trace will compare joint positions/velocities, projected body angular motion and receiver poses. Native preflight and acquisition remain pending.
detail.zh: 45 项先合法档案、解析 CPU 检查通过。新 trace 将对比关节位置/速度、刚体角运动投影与接收杯位姿。native 预检与实采尚待完成。

denominator.en: CPU checks only · 0 new scientific samples
denominator.zh: 仅 CPU 检查 · 0 新科学样本

notes: Development diagnostics and CPU controls are excluded from scientific denominators.
The public subset omits credentials, private paths, licensed simulator assets and unpublished manuscript files.
This is a versioned snapshot, not a live measurement stream.
